## Ykrez Client

Ykrez Client is a lightweight, server-legal quality-of-life client for Fabric. It gives you a clean, fully customizable HUD, a handful of useful visual tweaks, and an in-game menu you can arrange however you like — no cheats, no hacks, nothing that puts your account at risk. It's built for players who just want a better-looking and more informative Minecraft.

**Minecraft 1.21.11 | Fabric | Java 21**

## HUD

Show exactly the info you want on screen: FPS, FPS graph, CPS and right-click CPS, coordinates, speed, facing direction, yaw/pitch, ping, real-time clock, in-game day, biome, health, hunger, XP level, held item, armor display, player count, memory usage, session timer, keystrokes (WASD and mouse), an enabled-module list, and a watermark.

## Visual tweaks

Fullbright, Zoom, an adjustable FOV, and a custom crosshair.

## Movement helpers

Toggle Sprint and Toggle Sneak.

## Customizable menu

- All-black, rounded, animated menu with category dropdowns
- Draggable panels so you can lay the menu out your way
- Scroll to pan when you have a lot enabled
- Right-click any module to open its settings — sliders and toggles let you set your exact FOV, zoom level, gamma, crosshair size, and more
- Everything saves automatically and is restored the next time you launch

## Controls

- Right Shift — open the menu
- V — Zoom
- B — Fullbright
- R — Toggle Sprint

All keys are rebindable in Options > Controls. In the menu: left-click toggles a module, right-click opens its settings, drag a header to move a column, and scroll to pan.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader (0.16 or newer)
- Fabric API
- Java 21

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for 1.21.11.
2. Place Fabric API and the Ykrez Client jar in your mods folder.
3. Launch the game and press Right Shift to open the menu.

Ykrez is a legitimate utility client — it only adds HUD, display, and convenience features. It does not include any combat, movement, or world-exploit cheat modules.

Made by ERTZ.
